feeds.title: Australian Writers' Centre Blog
feeds.description: The Australian Writers' Centre helps you get published and write with confidence. Start your writing journey here! Read writing industry news, tips for writers and our famous Q&As.

feeds.title: Australian Women Writers Challenge
feeds.description: Supporting and promoting books by Australian women. A network of readers, reviewers and bloggers, helping to raise awareness of quality Australian women's writing via an online reading/reviewing challenge.

feeds.title: Emerging Writer's Festival Blog
feeds.description: The Emerging Writers' Festival (EWF) exists to promote the interests of emerging writers to improve their opportunities for professional development and their engagement with the broader public. The festival mixes emerging literary professionals with more established writers to forge a better understanding between the past and future of Australian writing, and to bring a high level of intellectual endeavour to all the festival's activities.

feeds.title: Writers
feeds.description: Our blog get you up-to-date on what we have been talking, reading and writing about. Also we share a few tricks from what we know. Writers is a first-rate writing agency that collaborates with businesses to amplifying their brand to produce compelling digital content.

feeds.title: Writerful Books Blog
feeds.description: Writerful Books is an author services company based in Melbourne, Australia. We provide a range of services such as beta reading, sensitivity reading, book editing and manuscript assessments to give our authors the best chance of success in having their books published and reaching a larger number of readers.

feeds.title: Writing NSW Blog
feeds.description: On Writing, our writing blog, is your source for news and resources from Writing NSW. Keep up with the latest literary events, find inspiration with our member successes, and get equipped with tools to sharpen your writing.

feeds.title: Doctoral Writing
feeds.description: DoctoralWriting is a forum where people who are interested in doctoral writing can come together to share information, resources, ideas, dreams in a spirit of building knowledge and skills around higher degree research writing.

feeds.title: Australasian Christian Writers
feeds.description: Australasian Christian Writers is a community of Christian readers and writers from Australia, New Zealand, and the South Pacific who join together to discuss books, reading, writing, and reviewing.

feeds.title: Melbourne Writers Festival Blog
feeds.description: Melbourne Writers Festival brings together artists from around the world to celebrate literature and explore ideas.

feeds.title: Writers SA Blog
feeds.description: Blog articles showcasing News, Updates, and Creative Responsed from our community. Stay tuned for exciting contest alerts. Writers SA is the peak organisation for writing and literature in South Australia. We support, showcase, and connect writers across the state and beyond.

feeds.title: Author Services Australia Blog
feeds.description: This is Author Services Australia Blog providing essential writing resources to aspiring and professional writers. Learn from experts the tricks of creative and attractive language. Author Services Australia provides publishing assistance to self-published authors, including editing, layout, formatting, and design.

feeds.title: Writers Victoria » Writing Life
feeds.description: Dive into an ocean of information, inspiration and insights into the writing life. Writers Victoria is here to help with your creative writing chores. Writers Victoria supports and connects writers across Victoria at all stages of development.
